description: This file is the main entry point for an Angular application. It imports core Angular functionalities, defines a standalone root component, and bootstraps the application with production optimizations enabled if the environment indicates a production build.

classes.name: AppComponent
classes.description: A simple standalone root component serving as the entry point of the Angular application.

methods.name: enableProdMode
methods.description: Enables Angular's production mode optimizations to improve performance.

methods.name: bootstrapApplication
methods.description: Bootstraps the Angular application with the specified root component.
